limitations: Platform support is intentionally scoped to Apple silicon macOS 14+ (darwin-arm64); Intel macOS (x86_64), macOS 13, Windows, and Linux are not complete transcription replacements pending repository owner policy or new cross-platform AVID Core backends, and fail closed in runtime/transcription-platform-support.json and CI.

Review runner execution in input.json covered Rust workspace tests, cargo fmt/clippy, Ruby AVID snapshot verification, check_no_python.sh, Python packaging/publication unit tests, and macOS SwiftPM unit tests; it did not execute helpers/avid_transcriber SwiftPM tests (AVIDTranscriberTests), Qt CTest binaries, FFmpeg-dependent native media contract tests (media_contract, core031_native), or live multi-gigabyte model downloads and inference.
Owner decision remains pending on whether Intel Mac, macOS 13, Windows x64/ARM64, and Linux x64/ARM64 may ship with transcription unavailable or must wait for shared AVID Core inference parity.

13 Rust tests and 2 Swift tests that require external FFmpeg binaries, the built avid-transcriber helper, or live model weights were ignored/skipped in the review runner environment; live MLX/Core ML inference, full app-bundle codesign/Xcode packaging, and non-macOS target builds were not re-executed in this review.
